title: DOJ confirms release of all detained 233 Asean Summit protesters

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Department of Justice (DOJ) confirmed that Muntinlupa prosecutors dismissed the complaints of malicious mischief, alarms and scandals against all 233 individuals arrested during a protest march ahead of the Asean Summit. As a result, the prosecutors ordered the release of the demonstrators. In a statement issued Wednesday evening, DOJ spokesperson Atty. Polo Martinez detailed the status of the detainees—comprising 213 adults and 20 minors.
